title: [D1] Create src/extras/js/engine.rs with JS thread loop and Runtime lifecycle
description:
Implement the dedicated OS thread that owns the QuickJS Runtime and Context.

Spec: docs/specs/phase-1-js-engine.md §Threading model, §Runtime lifecycle
Target: src/extras/js/engine.rs (to be created)

Key invariants this file must uphold:
1. Fresh Runtime::new() for EVERY run_step() call — never reuse (OOM poisons allocator)
2. set_memory_limit(MEMORY_LIMIT) and set_max_stack_size(STACK_LIMIT) on every new Runtime
3. set_interrupt_handler deadline set BEFORE ctx.eval() is called
4. Use eval::<Value, _> (not eval::<(), _>) to capture return value and exception stack
5. Drain microtask queue after every eval: while rt.execute_pending_job() == Ok(true) {}
6. Context dropped before Runtime (RAII order enforced by local scope)

Functions:
- pub fn js_thread_main(rx: mpsc::Receiver<JsRequest>) — the thread entry point; loops on rx.recv()
- pub(crate) fn run_step(code: &str) -> JsOutcome — creates Runtime, evals code, returns outcome
  (pub(crate) required: Phase 3 verify_skill() calls this cross-module)

Exact implementation in spec (copy verbatim, critical invariants baked in).

Feature gate: --features js

## Acceptance criteria
- cargo test --features js compiles with engine module
- run_step creates a new Runtime for each call (no Runtime field on any struct)
- Infinite loop in JS returns JsOutcome::Timeout (not a panic or hang)
- OOM allocation in JS returns JsOutcome::OomKilled (not a panic)
- Exception messages include JS stack trace (line numbers present)
- run_step is pub(crate) (not pub) matching Phase 3 cross-module call requirement
- Microtask queue drained after every eval

## Out of scope
- Host global registration (host.rs provides register_host_globals; this file calls it)
- Permission routing for spawn() (host.rs concern)
- Integration with builder.rs (wiring bead)

title: [D1] Inject top-K skill preamble into JS context before each agent step
description:
Implement the Voyager-style preamble injection that prepends top-3 skill bodies to each JS step.

Spec: docs/specs/phase-3-skill-library.md §preamble injection
Target: src/extras/js/engine.rs (extend run_step) and/or src/extras/js/tool.rs (extend call())

Mechanism:
1. Before each run_step(), retrieve top-3 skills from SkillStore by cosine similarity to the incoming code
2. Prepend their source as a preamble block in the JS string passed to ctx.eval()
3. Skills unavailable (store uninitialized, no skills yet) → run_step proceeds normally (no preamble)

Preamble format (injected before user code):
  // --- Skills ---
  <skill1.source>
  <skill2.source>
  <skill3.source>
  // --- End Skills ---
  <user_code>

The SkillStore must be accessible from the call site. Options: pass store reference through JsRequest, or hold an Arc<SkillStore> in JsTool.

update_embedding path: after inject, if a skill's embedding is NULL, trigger embed() and store it (lazy embedding).

Feature gate: --features js,skills

## Acceptance criteria
- cargo test --features js,skills: a skill in the store is callable from user JS code without explicit import
- cargo test --features js (no skills): preamble injection absent (no compilation error, no behavior change)
- Skills with NULL embedding are embedded on first retrieval (lazy embed)
- If store has 0 skills, eval proceeds without preamble (no error)
- Preamble does not leak into error messages returned to LLM

## Out of scope
- Auto-admission / propose_skill() (Phase 4)
- Manual skill add CLI command (not specified in Phase 3 spec)
- Top-K parameter configuration (hardcoded k=3 per spec)

title: [D1] Implement fastembed embedding wrapper and top-K retrieval in skills/embed.rs
description:

Responsibilities:

SQL schema:
  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS skills (
      id          TEXT    PRIMARY KEY,
      source      TEXT    NOT NULL,
      description TEXT    NOT NULL,
      tests       TEXT    NOT NULL,   -- JSON array of strings
      created_at  INTEGER NOT NULL,
      usage_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

title: [D1] Enable reqwest blocking feature in Cargo.toml for Phase 2 fetch()
description:
Add features = ["blocking"] to the existing reqwest entry so Phase 2 fetch() can use reqwest::blocking on the dedicated JS thread.

Spec: docs/specs/phase-2-sandbox.md §reqwest note
Target: Cargo.toml at repo root — existing reqwest entry at line 67

Current entry (do NOT duplicate):
  reqwest = "0.13"  (or similar minimal form)

Change to:
  reqwest = { version = "0.13", features = ["blocking"] }

IMPORTANT: Do NOT add a second reqwest entry. Modify the existing one at line 67.

Why blocking: reqwest::blocking is needed because fetch() runs on the dedicated JS thread which has no tokio runtime. Using reqwest::blocking avoids nested tokio runtime errors.

## Acceptance criteria
- Cargo.toml has exactly one reqwest entry (no duplicate)
- reqwest entry includes features = ["blocking"]
- cargo test --features js,sandbox compiles with reqwest::blocking available
